# Dugar Earthmovers — Tata Hitachi Nepal

> Dugar Earthmovers is the authorised Tata Hitachi distributor for Nepal, part
> of the MV Dugar Group. It sells, commissions and services excavators,
> backhoe loaders and mining equipment, and supplies genuine Tata Hitachi
> parts, from ten branches across the country.

## Facts

- Authorised Tata Hitachi Construction Machinery distributor for Nepal.
- Part of MV Dugar Group (https://www.mvdugar.com/), a five-generation family business.
- Ten service and parts branches: Kathmandu (HQ), Biratnagar, Pokhara, Jeetpur,
  Bardibaas, Nepalgunj, Dhangadi, Surkhet, Dang and Butwal.
- Factory-trained technicians typically reach a project site within 24–48 hours
  anywhere in Nepal.
- Machine range: ZAXIS excavators (140 H, 220 LC, 370 LCH Ultra, 650 H),
  EX Prime series excavators (70 Super, 130, 210 LC Prime, 215, 350 LC Prime),
  and the Shinrai Power backhoe loader.
- Sales: +977 9802591430 · Service: +977 9801571065 · sales.tatahitachinp@gmail.com

## Notes

- Prices are quoted per enquiry and are not published on the site.
- Machine specifications are manufacturer figures and are a guide, not a contract.
